mapper.select: SELECT id, code, title, suiteRoom, suiteHall, suiteBathroom, area, direction, floor, totalFloor, birth, housebelong, price, decoration, property, propertyrights, salesman, housestatus, detailed_address, contact_wechat, highlights, rental_reqs, description FROM t_houseinformation WHERE code = #{code}

SELECT id, code, title, suiteRoom, suiteHall, suiteBathroom, area, direction, floor, totalFloor, birth, housebelong, price, decoration, property, propertyrights, salesman, housestatus, detailed_address, contact_wechat, highlights, rental_reqs, description FROM t_houseinformation WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT h.id, h.code, h.title, h.suiteRoom, h.suiteHall, h.suiteBathroom, h.area, h.direction, h.floor, h.totalFloor, h.birth, h.housebelong, h.price, h.decoration, h.property, h.propertyrights, h.salesman, h.housestatus, h.detailed_address, h.contact_wechat, h.highlights, h.rental_reqs, h.description FROM t_houseinformation h JOIN t_user_behavior b ON b.house_id = h.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.behavior_type = #{behaviorType} GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY MAX(b.create_time) DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_houseinformation( code, title, suiteRoom, suiteHall, suiteBathroom, area, direction, floor, totalFloor, birth, housebelong, price, decoration, property, propertyrights, salesman, housestatus, detailed_address, contact_wechat, highlights, rental_reqs, description ) VALUES( #{houseinfo.code}, #{houseinfo.title}, #{houseinfo.suiteRoom}, #{houseinfo.suiteHall}, #{houseinfo.suiteBathroom}, #{houseinfo.area}, #{houseinfo.direction}, #{houseinfo.floor}, #{houseinfo.totalFloor}, #{houseinfo.birth}, #{houseinfo.housebelong}, #{houseinfo.price}, #{houseinfo.decoration}, #{houseinfo.property}, #{houseinfo.propertyrights}, #{houseinfo.salesman}, #{houseinfo.housestatus}, #{houseinfo.detailedAddress}, #{houseinfo.contactWechat}, #{houseinfo.highlights}, #{houseinfo.rentalReqs}, #{houseinfo.description} )
mapper.select: SELECT code, t_housephoto.photocode, title, location, description, savingfilename, originalfilename, contenttype FROM `t_housephoto`, `t_img` WHERE t_housephoto.photocode = t_img.photocode AND code = #{code}

SELECT h.id, h.code, h.title, h.suiteRoom, h.suiteHall, h.suiteBathroom, h.area, h.direction, h.floor, h.totalFloor, h.birth, h.housebelong, h.price, h.decoration, h.property, h.propertyrights, h.salesman, h.housestatus, h.detailed_address, h.contact_wechat, h.highlights, h.rental_reqs, h.description FROM t_houseinformation h LEFT JOIN t_user_behavior b ON b.house_id = h.id AND b.behavior_type = 2 WHERE IFNULL(h.housestatus, '') != '已售' GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
